entries.proposition: The review states the design: energy relays from the first fluorophore to the second and then the third, and the arrangement is meant to prevent direct transfer from the first to the third because their emission and excitation ranges do not overlap.
entries.snippet: The energy transfer strategy is designed so that emitted energy from the first protein does not go directly to the third one, as there is no overlap in the emission and the excitation energy range.

entries.proposition: The review states that the complex formation seen by FRET is of ectopic proteins: when ectopic WWOX, Smad4 and Hyal-2 are transiently overexpressed in the cytoplasm, hyaluronan induces complex formation of these ectopic proteins and bubbling cell death; the endogenous behaviour of the complex is a separate claim cited to earlier work.
entries.snippet: when ectopic WWOX, Smad4 and Hyal-2 are transiently overexpressed in the cytoplasm, HA/Hyal-2 signaling induces complex formation of these ectopic proteins to cause bubbling cell death
entries.anchor: Perspectives, paragraph on endogenous HA/Hyal-2 signalling
